Name: Luny's Summer Witch Attire for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/cmyb9Kz.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center]Just a small Fashion Sense pack for a long button-down sundress and witch hat. The hat includes two sizes for preference, the one shown
in the screenshots in the large hat. The hats also cast a shadow over the character's face for a touch of mysteriousness.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ to work! The outfit can be accessed via the FS mirror item.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/DIDaViU.png[/img]﻿

Extract the file and move the folder "[FS] Luny's Summer Witch Attire" to your StardewValley/Mods folder. Done!


Thanks for checking out my mods!
